# tfutils Provider

Resources that wait until a condition holds: on destroy, so that a controller is not removed before it finishes its cleanup, and on create, so that later resources do not call an endpoint before it is ready. AWS credentials come from `access_key`, `secret_key` and `token`, from the `assume_role_with_web_identity` block, or from the AWS SDK default chain when neither is set. Use one provider alias per AWS account. `tfutils_aws_eks_nodes_ready_wait` reaches the Kubernetes API of an EKS cluster with these AWS credentials alone. The `tfutils_kubernetes_*` resources connect to the cluster in the `kubernetes` block; it accepts ephemeral values, so a token from an ephemeral resource stays out of the plan and state, and its `exec` block runs a credential plugin for applies that outlive one token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "tfutils" {
  region = "ap-northeast-2"
}

provider "tfutils" {
  alias  = "route53"
  region = "us-east-1"

  access_key = var.route53_access_key
  secret_key = var.route53_secret_key
  token      = var.route53_session_token
}

variable "web_identity_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  ephemeral = true
}

provider "tfutils" {
  alias  = "web_identity"
  region = "ap-northeast-2"

  assume_role_with_web_identity {
    role_arn           = "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/tfutils"
    web_identity_token = var.web_identity_token
    session_name       = "tfutils"
    duration           = "1h"
  }
}

variable "cluster_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  ephemeral = true
}

provider "tfutils" {
  alias = "cluster"

  kubernetes {
    host                   = module.eks.cluster_endpoint
    cluster_ca_certificate = base64decode(module.eks.cluster_certificate_authority_data)
    token                  = var.cluster_token
  }
}

provider "tfutils" {
  alias = "cluster_exec"

  kubernetes {
    host                   = module.eks.cluster_endpoint
    cluster_ca_certificate = base64decode(module.eks.cluster_certificate_authority_data)

    exec {
      api_version = "client.authentication.k8s.io/v1beta1"
      command     = "aws"
      args        = ["eks", "get-token", "--cluster-name", module.eks.cluster_name]
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `access_key` (String, Sensitive) AWS access key ID. Set together with `secret_key`.
- `assume_role_with_web_identity` (Block, Optional) Assume an IAM role with an OIDC token through STS `AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity`, in the same shape as the block of the `hashicorp/aws` provider. Conflicts with `access_key`, `secret_key` and `token`, and needs `region`. The values are read when the provider is configured and the token is not read again, so credentials cannot be renewed after the token expires. It accepts ephemeral values, so a token from an ephemeral resource stays out of the plan and state. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--assume_role_with_web_identity))
- `kubernetes` (Block, Optional) Kubernetes API server used by the `tfutils_kubernetes_*` resources. The values may be unknown during plan, for example when the cluster is created in the same apply; the resources call the API server only during apply. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--kubernetes))
- `region` (String) AWS region of the resources to watch. Required by the `tfutils_aws_*` resources.
- `secret_key` (String, Sensitive) AWS secret access key. Set together with `access_key`.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) AWS session token for temporary credentials.

<a id="nestedblock--assume_role_with_web_identity"></a>
### Nested Schema for `assume_role_with_web_identity`

Optional:

- `duration` (String) Duration of the role session, between `15m` and `12h`, for example `1h`. STS uses its default of one hour when it is not set.
- `role_arn` (String) ARN of the IAM role to assume. Required in the block.
- `session_name` (String) Role session name. The AWS SDK generates one when it is not set.
- `web_identity_token` (String, Sensitive) OIDC ID token that the role trusts. Required in the block.


<a id="nestedblock--kubernetes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `kubernetes`

Optional:

- `cluster_ca_certificate` (String) PEM-encoded CA certificate of the API server. The system roots are used when it is not set.
- `exec` (Block, Optional) Credential plugin that issues the bearer token, in the same shape as the block of the `hashicorp/kubernetes` provider. Conflicts with `token`. The token is cached in the provider process and the command runs again only when the token expires or the API server answers 401, so an apply can outlive one token. The command runs where Terraform runs and must be installed there. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--kubernetes--exec))
- `host` (String) URL of the API server, for example `https://ABCD.gr7.ap-northeast-2.eks.amazonaws.com`. Required in the block.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Bearer token. When it is a JWT, the resources fail as soon as its `exp` passes instead of waiting for the timeout. Conflicts with `exec`.

<a id="nestedblock--kubernetes--exec"></a>
### Nested Schema for `kubernetes.exec`

Optional:

- `api_version` (String) API version of the `ExecCredential` that the command prints, for example `client.authentication.k8s.io/v1beta1`. Required in the block.
- `args` (List of String) Arguments of the command, for example `["eks", "get-token", "--cluster-name", "example"]`.
- `command` (String) Command to run, for example `aws`. Required in the block.
- `env` (Map of String) Environment variables added to the environment of the provider process when the command runs.
